title: Game nights
description: One row per game from the players' uploaded logs. Times are in your browser's time zone.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM matches m WHERE m.started_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
SELECT ROUND(SUM(frames)/SUM(duration_s),1) FROM matches m WHERE m.started_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()

panels.title: Frozen minutes

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(frozen_s)/60,1) FROM matches m WHERE m.started_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()

panels.description: Per game, the total stall time of the player who stalled the most, summed over games.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.match_id, s.frame) FROM stalls s JOIN matches m USING (match_id) WHERE s.waited_ms >= 5000 AND m.started_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
SELECT SUM(desync > 0) FROM matches m WHERE m.started_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()

SELECT started_at AS Started, map AS Map, humans AS Players, router_name AS Router, version AS Version, ROUND(duration_s/60) AS Minutes, ROUND(sim_fps,1) AS `Speed fps`, slowest_name AS `Held speed down`, ROUND(frozen_s) AS `Frozen s`, ROUND(frozen_s*3600/duration_s) AS `Frozen s per hour`, ROUND(worst_stall_ms/1000,1) AS `Worst freeze s`, disc_screens AS `Disconnect screens`, desync AS Desync, CONCAT(reports,'/',humans) AS `Logs in`, match_id AS `Match`, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(started_at)*1000 - 60000 AS from_ms, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(ended_at)*1000 + 60000 AS to_ms FROM matches m WHERE m.started_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() ORDER BY started_at DESC

panels.title: Frozen seconds per hour of play, per game

targets.rawSql: SELECT started_at AS time, frozen_s*3600/duration_s AS `Frozen s per hour` FROM matches m WHERE m.started_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() ORDER BY 1
SELECT started_at AS time, sim_fps AS `Speed fps` FROM matches m WHERE m.started_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Who the game waited on

targets.rawSql: SELECT b.blamed AS Player, COUNT(DISTINCT b.match_id) AS Games, ROUND(SUM(b.stall_s)) AS `Stall s caused`, SUM(b.stalls) AS `Logged stalls` FROM blame b JOIN matches m USING (match_id) WHERE m.started_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() GROUP BY b.blamed ORDER BY 3 DESC

panels.description: From NETSTALL lines (stalls of 0.5 s or more, at most one every 5 s per player). 'several' = waiting on more than one player.

targets.rawSql: SELECT router_name AS Router, COUNT(*) AS Games, ROUND(AVG(humans),1) AS `Avg players`, ROUND(SUM(frames)/SUM(duration_s),1) AS `Speed fps`, ROUND(SUM(frozen_s)*3600/SUM(duration_s)) AS `Frozen s per hour`, ROUND(MAX(worst_stall_ms)/1000,1) AS `Worst freeze s` FROM matches m WHERE m.started_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() GROUP BY router_name ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT humans AS Players, COUNT(*) AS Games, ROUND(SUM(frames)/SUM(duration_s),1) AS `Speed fps`, ROUND(SUM(frozen_s)*3600/SUM(duration_s)) AS `Frozen s per hour`, ROUND(MAX(worst_stall_ms)/1000,1) AS `Worst freeze s` FROM matches m WHERE m.started_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() GROUP BY humans ORDER BY 1

panels.title: By release

targets.rawSql: SELECT m.version AS Version, COUNT(*) AS Games, ROUND(SUM(frames)/SUM(duration_s),1) AS `Speed fps`, ROUND(SUM(frozen_s)*3600/SUM(duration_s)) AS `Frozen s per hour`, SUM(desync > 0) AS Desyncs, SUM(humans) - SUM(reports) AS `Missing logs`, MIN(started_at) AS `First game` FROM matches m WHERE m.started_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() GROUP BY m.version ORDER BY 7 DESC

panels.description: Missing logs = players in the roster whose log never arrived (crash, kill, or quit before upload).

panels.title: Whose PC held the game speed down (2.1.6 and later clients only)

targets.rawSql: SELECT p.name AS Player, COUNT(*) AS Games, ROUND(SUM(p.held_back * m.duration_s)/60, 1) AS `Minutes holding speed down`, ROUND(AVG(p.rep_fps)) AS `Avg PC fps`, ROUND(AVG(p.client_ms),1) AS `Client ms`, ROUND(AVG(p.logic_ms),1) AS `Logic ms` FROM match_players p JOIN matches m USING (match_id) WHERE p.rep_fps IS NOT NULL AND m.started_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY 3 DESC

panels.description: The router sets everyone's speed to the lowest PC fps. Client ms high = drawing is the limit (graphics settings, GPU); logic ms high = the CPU cannot keep up with the simulation.
